bugs_found: apply_fee treats fee_pct as a whole multiplier instead of a percentage; e.g. 2 means 200% fee, not 2%
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min or computed fee exceeds amount
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/int inputs can cause Decimal arithmetic TypeError or inconsistent Receipt amount type
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months via int(), producing incorrect results instead of rejecting invalid periods
